description:
Seen twice (2026-11-11, 0.25-0.26). An agent asked the owner a question over `muster msg`, then ran `"$MUSTER_DAEMON" report --waiting ... --until-message-from @human`, and then with the owner's name. Both were refused: "nobody here or on a machine linked to this one is called @human", though `muster msg who` lists the person as `@human`. A wait on the person's answer is the most common wait an agent declares, and the session-start hook tells agents to name the sender.

Accept `@human` (and the person's name) as a sender, the way `msg post --to` does. From tooling feedback a_2xuR6Uxfk and a_2xw1HCBmf.
title: report --until-message-from refuses the human, so a pane cannot declare it waits on the person
